----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Kishan Lal Sharma with Mr. Saurabh Jain For Respondent(s) : Mr. Rishi Raj Singh Rathore, PP with Mr. Manvendra Singh Shekhawat, PP

Mr.
Namish Nigotia HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAMEER JAIN Order 07/10/2024 1.

This petition under Section 528 B.N.S.S., 2023 is filed, with a prayer to quash the FIR No.702/2019 registered at Police Station Kardhani, District Jaipur (West) for offences under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B of IPC, on the basis of compromise effectuated between the parties herein, in respect of their inter-se dispute.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that present is a dispute, which is commercial in nature.
The dispute is inter-se between the parties and has no bearing on the society at large.
[2024:RJ-JP:42131] (2 of 3) [CRLMP-5950/2024] Learned counsel has also submitted that at the present time there is a trial ongoing qua the dispute.

3. Both the parties have marked presence in the Court (identified by their respective counsel) and have submitted that they have amicably decided to put a quietus to the instant dispute, and for the same, they have also entered into a compromise.
4. Learned counsel for both the parties have submitted that the dispute at hand is inter-se private in nature, which has been resolved by the parties amicably.

1 5.
Heard and considered.

6. At the outset, this Court deems it appropriate to place reliance upon the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Apex Court in Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab [(2012) 10 SCC 303] and Ramgopal Vs. The State of Madhya Pradesh reported in [2022 (14) SCC 531], relevant portion of which is reproduced below:
"12. The High Court, therefore, having regard to the nature of the offence and the fact that parties have amicably settled their dispute and the victim has willingly consented to the nullification of criminal proceedings, can quash such proceedings in exercise of its inherent powers under Section 528 B.N.S.S., even if the offences are non- compoundable."
7.

sentences.text: In view of the position of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in aforementioned case, and considering the personal nature of dispute, which has been amicably settled between parties, this Court deems it just and proper to allow the present misc. petition.
Compromise is taken on record.

8. Considering the aforementioned, the present criminal miscellaneous petition is allowed and the FIR No. 702/2019 registered at Police Station Kardhani, District Jaipur (West) with all consequential proceedings, are hereby quashed and set aside.
9. Accordingly, the instant petition is allowed.
Pending application(s), if any, stand disposed of.
